build_vit_model: build a Vision Transformer model using the Model factory with a variant string like B/16
decode_variant_params: decode a ViT variant string like B/32 into width, depth, mlp_dim, and num_heads params
create_sincos_posemb: create 2D sincos positional embeddings for a given grid height, width, and embedding dimension
resample_positional_embeddings: resample positional embeddings from an old grid size to a new one for high-res fine-tuning
load_vit_checkpoint: load ViT model parameters from a checkpoint file with automatic format conversion and posemb resampling
